title: Why We Have School Adventure
meta_desc: School & Education Adventure 1 — KS3 Sociology on the role of school in society.
final_note: You learned the main functions of school in society.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Sociologists say school does several jobs:

  • Teach subjects.
  • Socialise children into norms.
  • Prepare for work.
  • Give equal chances.

The hidden curriculum isn't on the timetable:

  • Lining up.
  • Hands up to speak.
  • Wearing uniform.
  • Respecting authority.

You learn these without anyone teaching them. 🤫

School also helps society as a whole:

  • Sorts people into roles.
  • Spreads shared values.
  • Builds the future workforce.

Hence why UK school is compulsory from 5 to 18 (in some form). 📚
